text:
ryan: Quick design flag from today's hallway test — Batch > Vectors preview -> Export has three small UX/A11y friction points. Screenshot: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/vecs-legend (attached)
ryan: Issues observed: 1) Export button label and the tiny tag showing format (CSV) feel disconnected, users miss the tag. 2) Hover tooltip for column mapping is easy to miss and isn't keyboard accessible. 3) Relevance table sorting shows scores as truncated floats (0.8123) with no scale hint.
maria: Good catch. For 1) can we combine the affordance: primary button reads "Download CSV" and a small secondary pill next to it says "Format: CSV" with a chevron to open formats. That pill should be focusable for keyboard users.
jamie: For the keyboard issue, the column-mapping tooltip should be a focusable disclosure rather than a transient hover tooltip. e.g. a "Columns" button that opens a small panel with a stable close button and tab trap.
lina: Accessibility notes: the "Format: CSV" pill should have aria-expanded when its menu is open and aria-controls pointing at the list. The Columns panel needs aria-labelledby and a role=dialog so screen readers announce it. Also add SR-only text describing relevance score scale: "Relevance: 0 to 1, higher is more relevant.".
aqil: Copy suggestion for the column panel header: "Columns included in export" and list sample columns: id, embedding_vector (truncated for preview), metadata.title. Also include a CSV size estimate like "~4 MB for 1k rows" to set expectations.
ryan: Nice. For relevance scores, testers didn't understand small differences (e.g., 0.812 vs 0.796). Maybe show scores as percentages with two digits and add a brief legend: "Score: 0-100, approximate similarity". That feels clearer.
maria: UX trade: percent looks friendlier, but we should keep raw score in a tooltip for power users. So table cell shows "81.2%" and tooltip shows "raw: 0.81234".
jamie: Also performance note: rendering tooltips for 10k rows is expensive. Use lazy tooltips that only mount on hover/focus, and debounce hover to avoid thrash.
lina: A11y: tooltips should be triggered on focus as well as hover and have role="status" if ephemeral, or role="dialog" if persistent. Column panel should trap focus and restore focus on close.
aqil: Telemetry: if we add a new "format_pill_click" event or change export label, we need to update the schema. Pinged eng-infra to confirm stable event names.
opsbot: Note: design review scheduled Fri 10:00 — please add final mocks by Thu EOD so PM & Eng can sign off.
ryan: Action items:
- Jamie: implement Columns disclosure pattern + lazy tooltips (PR)
- Lina: add detailed a11y annotations in Figma and sample aria attributes
- Aqil: update modal and pill copy + add CSV size copy
- Maria: update export button treatment and percentage legend
maria: I'll consolidate the changes into the Figma file and drop a short spec in the ticket. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
